source_text: Paulus doctor gentium tradidit ecclesiae quomodo libros legis advertere. Exempla intelligentiae dat, ut similia observemus. Profectio Istrahel — disciplina animae exeuntis de Aegypto vitiorum.
pass_a_gloss: Paul teacher of-nations handed-over to-church how books of-law to-regard. Examples of-understanding he-gives, that similar things we-may-observe. Departure of-Israel — training of-soul exiting from Egypt of-vices.
pass_b_english: [[Paul, teacher of the nations in faith and truth >> Bible:1 Timothy 2:7]], handed the Gentile church a way to read books of Law once foreign to them. He gives patterns of understanding so we may watch for like things. Israel’s departure is the soul’s schooling as it leaves the Egypt of the passions.
